## Time series

dayflow - cross channel gates
```{r dayflow, echo=false}
df1 <- read_csv("Data/Dayflow/dayflow-results-1970-1983.csv") %>%
  select(Year,Month,Date,XGEO)
df2 <- read_csv("Data/Dayflow/dayflow-results-1984-1996.csv") %>%
  select(Year,Month,Date,XGEO)
df3 <- read_csv("Data/Dayflow/dayflow-results-1997-2023.csv") %>%
  select(Year,Month,Date,XGEO)

df <- rbind(df1,df2,df3)
```

### daily whole time series
```{r daily ts}
#quick time series
df$Date <- mdy(df$Date)
df2223 <- df %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2022,2023))

plot(df$Date,df$XGEO,type="l")

```


### daily 2022-2023
```{r}
plot(df2223$Date,df2223$XGEO,type="l")
```


```{r monthly ts}
#summarize by month
df <- df %>%
  group_by(Year,Month) %>%
  summarize(XGEO = mean(XGEO)) %>%
  mutate(lagXGEO = lag(XGEO, n = 3))

# merge xgeo with chlorophyll

xc_chl <- wq_r_sum %>%
  merge(df,by=c("Year","Month"),all.y=T) %>%
  subset(Year >= 1979 & Year < 2023)

#calculate bloom
#Binary transformation of bloom absence/presence
bloom_thresholds <- xc_chl %>%
  group_by(Regions) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(Chlorophyll,na.rm=T),sd=sd(Chlorophyll,na.rm=T)) %>%
  mutate(bloom_thr = mean + sd) %>%
  select(-mean,-sd)

#add bloom presence/absence and xcg open/close
xc_chl <- xc_chl %>%
  merge(bloom_thresholds,by="Regions",all.x=T) %>%
  mutate(bloom = case_when(Chlorophyll > bloom_thr ~ 1,
                           Chlorophyll < bloom_thr ~ 0))

```


## XGEO vs Chlorophyll
```{r plot xgeo vs chl}

plot(xc_chl$XGEO,xc_chl$Chlorophyll)
abline(lm(xc_chl$Chlorophyll ~ xc_chl$XGEO), col = "red", lwd = 2)
```

## xgeo vs bloom
```{r plot xgeo vs bloom}
plot(xc_chl$XGEO,xc_chl$bloom)
```
## Regions

### North Delta
```{r North Delta Only}
xc_chl_n <- xc_chl %>% 
  filter(Regions %in% "North Delta")

plot(xc_chl_n$XGEO,xc_chl_n$bloom,main="XGEO vs bloom - North Delta")
plot(xc_chl_n$XGEO,xc_chl_n$Chlorophyll,main="XGEO vs Chlorophyll - North Delta")
abline(lm(xc_chl_n$Chlorophyll ~ xc_chl_n$XGEO), col = "red", lwd = 2)

```

### Central Delta
```{r North Delta Only}
xc_chl_n <- xc_chl %>% 
  filter(Regions %in% "Central")

plot(xc_chl_n$XGEO,xc_chl_n$bloom,main="XGEO vs bloom - Central Delta")
plot(xc_chl_n$XGEO,xc_chl_n$Chlorophyll,main="XGEO vs Chlorophyll - Central Delta")
abline(lm(xc_chl_n$Chlorophyll ~ xc_chl_n$XGEO), col = "red", lwd = 2)

```
